title: Palindromic Substrings
oneLinerQuestion: Count how many total palindromic substrings exist in a given string.
explanation: Expand outward from all candidate centers (i, i) for odd length palindromes and (i, i+1) for even length palindromes, incrementing total palindrome counter for matched boundaries.
pseudoCode:
FUNCTION countSubstrings(s):
    res = 0
    FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH(s) - 1 DO:
        res = res + countPalindromes(s, i, i)
        res = res + countPalindromes(s, i, i + 1)
    END FOR
    RETURN res
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION countPalindromes(s, l, r):
    count = 0
    WHILE l >= 0 AND r < LENGTH(s) AND s[l] == s[r] DO:
        count = count + 1; l = l - 1; r = r + 1
    END WHILE
    RETURN count
END FUNCTION
